description: Split-histogram decomposition of the raw |w| distribution by fixed suppressed-channel membership (the strict three-way set, n=5031 of 18944 intermediate channels).
residual_below_valley_mass: partially suppressed channels and the overlap tail of the main body
provenance: Computed by plot_FR_C5_decomposition.py on raw stored bf16 weights (block-1 W_gate/W_up/W_down); the raw weight inputs are too large to ship — channel membership and thresholds are reproducible from c5_channel_overlap_v1.json plus the released checkpoints.
